text:
Noah (People Ops): quick thread 1 candidate Mateo Cruz. Hiring requests cross-region pay parity and provisional band uplift for relocation + immediate benefits. Need routing for comp exception and expedited benefits enrollment. Packet: https://redwood-internal/hr/offers/mateo-cruz
Ivy (Hiring Manager): Mateo is a plum hire for infra observability. Asking L5->L6 provisional, base $175k -> $195k, one-time sign-on $20k (paid 50/50). Start target 2026-12-01, relocating from LATAM. Benefits need to cover first month family med.
Ben (Recruiter): candidate verbally accepted pending final offer and dependent benefit language. Wants confirmation on start and benefit effective date.
Sam (Finance): need GL and budget owner. >$15k uplift triggers comp-committee. Sign-on and dependent coverage need budget note.
Noah (People Ops): proposed numbers:
- Proposed base: $195,000 (provisional L6)
- Sign-on: $20,000 (50% at start, 50% at 6mo)
- Dependent stipend: $800/mo up to 2 months
- GL: 6101.1800; budget owner: eng-observability
Rationale: immediate program impact and retention risk due to competitor counteroffer.
Ava (Comp Committee): please attach manager statement and peer comps. We'll fast-track if docs are complete.
Ivy (Hiring Manager): uploaded comps and manager note: https://redwood-internal/docs/comp/mateo-2026.pdf
Legal (Legal): recommend dependent coverage clause and 12-month sign-on clawback. Uploading template and visa wording.
hr-bot: policy reminder: "Cross-region pay parity and dependent stipend requests require Comp Committee + VP Eng signoff" (policy HR-GEO-005). Template: /templates/dependent-stipend-amend.docx
Ava (Comp Committee): approved (fast-track) with provisional 90-day review. Added note: verify peer comps in HR form.
Sam (Finance): approved pending Legal text; budget reserved.
Legal (Legal): signed off on dependent clause and clawback language. Also noted tax implications for stipend.
Nadia (VP Eng): I approve provisional uplift for 90 days; require 60-day checkpoint.
Noah (People Ops): routing complete: comp-committee -> finance -> legal -> VP signoff. Offer scheduled to send at 16:00 PT. Ben to confirm acceptance after send. :thumbsup:
Ben (Recruiter): sending now. Will update when signed.
Noah (People Ops): closing note: reminder scheduled for 60-day checkpoint. Thanks all!
